comfort: Traditional over-ear fit. Check ageing pads and whether your ears touch the lining.
sound: Bass-forward tuning with active noise cancellation. Age alone does not determine your preferred sound.
eco: Foldable design; lacks the later models’ two-device multipoint.
codec: SBC, AAC, aptX, aptX HD, LDAC

comfort: Traditional padded design. Check ear-cup depth and pressure around glasses.
sound: Warm, bass-forward sound and premium ANC; not intended as a neutral default tuning.
eco: Foldable; multipoint disables LDAC on this model.

comfort: Slim headband and roomy pads. Check for concentrated pressure at the top of your head.
sound: Full, warm presentation with strong ANC. The tuning may not suit every listener.
eco: Minimal styling, non-folding frame; updated firmware supports LDAC with multipoint.

comfort: Wider headband and revised cushioning. Fit improvements remain dependent on your head shape.
sound: Warm presentation; same-method isolation comparisons favour it over XM5, though everyday gains vary.
eco: Folding frame and magnetic case; multipoint, LDAC and LC3 require compatible devices.

comfort: Lightweight over-ear option. Check the seal and stability when moving.
sound: Everyday listening with ANC and app EQ. No LDAC; codec support alone does not decide sound quality.
eco: Practical plastic build, physical controls and multipoint; does not fold inward.

comfort: Lightest here, but on-ear pads press directly on the ears. Check glasses and prolonged pressure.
sound: No active noise cancellation and limited passive isolation. Better suited to quiet surroundings.
eco: Compact on-ear design, multipoint and physical controls; no wired listening or supplied case.
